answers.core: This cannot be an add-on, as it requires a modification to the way GDScript itself is implemented.
answers.workaround: When it's necessary to specify that a variable contains no value, a way to flag that without using nullable types is to either maintain a parallel variable indicating the value is not valid or picking a specific value that is understood to mean the value is invalid. This, in my opinion, increases code complexity and makes it more prone to errors.
